title: Neon Afterglow
lyrics:
[Intro]
Glass reflects the passing light
Tires hum against the night
Static fades into the blue
City breathes, the engines too

[Verse 1]
Streetlamps bleed upon the glass
Tires trace the wet black line
Console lights paint the driver’s face
Time dissolves in endless space

[Pre-Chorus]
Glass rolls up to trap the heat
Pulse begins to match the beat
Mileage climbs beyond the chart
City fades behind the curve

[Chorus]
Chase the streaks of liquid gold
Drive until the edges blur
Leave the waking world behind
Neon afterglow pulls you home

[Bridge]
Wires spark across the dash
Signals slip into the gray
Tires hum a steady tone
Horizon melts away

[Outro]
Engine cools, lights go dim
Breathing slows, hands relax
Dawn arrives beyond the ridge
Quiet settles on the wheels
cover_prompt: A retro-futuristic digital painting in deep magenta, electric cyan, and molten gold captures a first-person view through a rain-streaked windshield during a solitary midnight drive. Volumetric neon glow washes over a glowing dashboard while wet asphalt mirrors long streaks of ambient light. Cinematic motion blur and a receding perspective grid create a hypnotic, weightless atmosphere that perfectly mirrors the drifting, nocturnal journey.
music_prompt: synthwave, late-night drive through neon-lit streets

title: Morning Gold
mood: first light over the bay, full of hope
lyrics:
[Intro]
Salt air wakes the dock
Tides pull back the night

[Verse 1]
Frost melts off the pine
Dew drops fall in time
Windows catch the flame
Shadows lose their claim

[Pre-Chorus]
Paint the wooden floor
Sweep the dust aside
Slide the window pane
Let the daylight in

[Chorus]
Silver wakes the bay
Clears the salt-stained air
We are stepping into gold
Catch the morning light

[Bridge]
Steam rises from cups
Seagulls call the fleet
Lines are cast against the wind
Ropes begin to strain

[Outro]
Gold spills on the sand
Day begins to climb
We are sailing past the break
Toward the open sea
cover_prompt: Vibrant indie-pop collage style featuring a wooden sailboat gliding toward a radiant sunrise over a shimmering bay. Colors transition from deep indigo shadows to explosive amber and rose-gold light reflecting on wet sand and rippling water. Dynamic composition with pine branches framing the scene, capturing the uplifting energy of new beginnings and salt-kissed hope. High contrast, textured paper grain, cinematic backlighting.
music_prompt: upbeat indie pop, first light over the bay, full of hope

title: Midnight Café
mood: rain on the window, cozy and warm
cover_prompt: A soft lo-fi watercolor frames a cozy café interior behind a rain-streaked window. Warm amber steam rises from a ceramic mug beside a worn vinyl sleeve, while muted terracotta chairs recede into shallow depth of field. Gentle streetlamp glow filters through droplets, casting hazy shadows on polished wood. This intimate composition balances quiet solitude with enveloping warmth, echoing the slow, dreamy pulse of late-night jazz.
